summary: Supply JavaScript undefined for missing formal arguments; do not use C# default(T) or optional-parameter defaults.

target.notes: The call adapter must bind absent formals to the distinct JS undefined value while preserving arguments.length as the number actually supplied.

semantics.default_parameters: run only when binding value is undefined

caveats: null is not a substitute for undefined.
Value-type C# parameters cannot represent omission without an explicit JS value layer.

tests.name: missing becomes undefined
tests.expected_behavior: b is undefined and arguments.length is 1
